correctness.rationale: Every strict unit-capacity profile is enumerated for \(n\le3\). At \(n=3\), two DA implementations and two TTC implementations agree on all \(46{,}656\) profiles. All six perfect matchings are separately checked for DA Pareto efficiency, and both canonical orbit reduction and Burnside counting yield the same \(30+84+6=120\) divergent classes. The actual package verifier returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Three-by-three is the first size at which these canonical school-choice mechanisms diverge. The exact \(5/54\) divergence rate, \(5/216\) TTC-improvement rate, \(1/216\) inefficient-but-incomparable rate, and \(120\)-class symmetry quotient quantify the core stability-versus-efficiency tradeoff at its sharp finite boundary. The six exceptional intrinsic types give a compact target for subsequent structural analysis.
